newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's Filinvest said clearance denied.
newsitem.headline: Manila's Filinvest said clearance denied.

text.p: The Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) has refused to grant an environmental clearance certificate (ECC) to a real estate development project of Filinvest Land Inc, FLI said on Monday.

FLI corporate secretary Dante Ramos, in a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange, said the DENR also informed Filinvest it had imposed a 50,000-peso penalty on the firm for alleged violation of the environmental impact assessment (EIA) law. The letter did not say what the alleged violation was.

Filinvest is appealing to President Fidel Ramos against the DENR decision, the letter said. "Our counsel is now preparing a motion for reconsideration and/or appeal to the Office of the President from aforesaid decision of the DENR Secretary contesting the alleged factual and legal bases relied on for the denial of the ECC," it said. FLI's Sky City project is a 667-hectare complex with houses, condominiums, resort hotels, commercial centres, recreational facilities and a golf course in San Mateo, Rizal, just east of the capital, Manila.
FLI earlier said it expected revenues to rise substantially in the second half of the year with the launching of the Sky City project.
